description: List, open, select or close the tabs of the browser session. list (the default): each tab's tab_id, url, title (null when the page did not answer in 3 s; a tab on a page the tools do not read has not_read:true, no title and the start of its address), whether it is the active page and whether browser_tabs opened it. new: opens a tab (url: http(s); file:// needs NORACU_ALLOW_FILE_URL=1) and makes it the active page. select: makes tab_id the active page — only a tab on an http(s) page (or file:// with NORACU_ALLOW_FILE_URL=1), or one still on the blank page it was opened on (tab_not_selectable otherwise). The other browser_* tools act on the active page only; a tab the page opens itself is listed, never followed. close: only a tab browser_tabs opened (tab_not_owned otherwise), never the last one. After new, select or closing the active tab, earlier element_index values no longer apply; when the active tab goes, the first tab select would take becomes the active page (none: no_active_page). An active tab that comes to show a page select would refuse stays the active page, and the other tools answer active_page_not_allowed — browser_navigate can take it to an http(s) page. new, select and close report delivery and retry.
name: browser_tabs
